summary: Frontend-only test pass for the new persistent 'Accepted (N)' state on the bulk-accept buttons in the Compliance Evidence panel (EvidenceSidebar.js). Tested on the live preview URL as manager@supervision.com (MFA bypassed via backend/tests/get_tokens.py, cookies injected) against meeting c20802af-17e3-4210-b497-13d09c9e67ec (in_review, 17 mappings). Created /app/backend/tests/_iter92_seed.py to backup/apply/restore three confidence+status scenarios directly in analyses JSONB; original data fully restored afterwards (verified: 13 cqc possible/accepted + 4 care_cert possible/pending, exactly as before). ALL 8 requested behaviours PASS. Scenario A (4 likely: 1 pre-accepted + 3 pending; 13 possible pending): both buttons render as <button>; clicking accept-all-likely-btn shows toast '3 items accepted' and the SAME data-testid element becomes a <span> reading 'Accepted (4)' (mixed count = individually-accepted + bulk-accepted, correct), emerald border/bg/text, cursor-default, CheckCheck icon, title 'All 4 likely evidence items accepted'; the possible button stayed a normal actionable <button> (regression OK). Clicking the badge again does nothing (no toast, no state change, no network call — it is a plain span). Then accept-all-possible-btn -> toast '13 items accepted' -> span 'Accepted (13)' with amber styling. Full page reload + re-open Compliance tab: both badges still render 'Accepted (4)' / 'Accepted (13)' -> persistence from analysis mappings confirmed. Scenario B (zero likely-tier items at all): likely button stays a normal <button>, click shows the info toast 'No pending items in that category to accept' and does NOT flip to 'Accepted (0)'. Scenario C (3 likely items ALL rejected -> pending=0, accepted=0): likely button correctly stays a normal <button> (no misleading 'Accepted (0)'), click shows the same info toast. Per-card regression on an individual card: Accept -> 'Accepted', Reject -> 'Rejected', Flag -> 'Needs Follow-up' all still work and persist in the card header.

issues: The toast container renders UNDER the app header's user menu: the header text 'Demo Manager' bleeds through the toast, clipping/overlapping the message ('No pending items in that category to accept' is unreadable at its right end). Pre-existing z-index/stacking issue, not caused by this change, but it makes the info toast for the empty-tier case hard to read. Reproduced in both Scenario B and Scenario C screenshots.

action_items: Optional (cosmetic, pre-existing): raise the toast container z-index above the header/user-menu so toast text isn't overlapped.
critical_code_review_comments: EvidenceSidebar.js: bulkTierStats() is recomputed on every render for both tiers over allMappings (O(n) x2). Fine at 17 mappings, but since the component is React.memo'd for perf reasons already, consider folding the two passes into one useMemo keyed on the three mapping arrays.

EvidenceSidebar.js: the read-only badge reuses the SAME data-testid as the actionable button (accept-all-likely-btn / accept-all-possible-btn). That matches the request, but tests must assert on tagName/text; if you ever want cleaner assertions, add a secondary attribute such as data-state="accepted|actionable".

EvidenceSidebar.js: a tier with e.g. 2 accepted + 1 rejected + 0 pending renders 'Accepted (2)' while the tier holds 3 items — intentional per the spec (N = accepted count), but the title text 'All 2 likely evidence items accepted' is then slightly inaccurate ('all' isn't true). Consider 'N of M accepted' in the tooltip only.
Minor: the badge is a <span> with a title only — no aria-label/role. A screen reader still reads 'Accepted (4)', so acceptable, but role="status" would announce the transition.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (8/8 in-scope scenarios incl. persistence, zero-item tier, all-rejected tier, mixed count, other-tier regression, per-card regression)

seed_data_creation: Temporarily mutated confidence/status of the existing mappings on analysis of meeting c20802af-17e3-4210-b497-13d09c9e67ec (3 scenarios) via _iter92_seed.py; original JSONB backed up to /tmp/iter92_backup.json and restored at the end (verified identical to the pre-test state). No new meetings/users created.
test_credentials: manager@supervision.com / Manager123! — MFA bypassed via `python3 backend/tests/get_tokens.py manager@supervision.com 'Manager123!'`, cookies injected into the Playwright context for evidence-link-4.preview.emergentagent.com
context_for_next_testing_agent: The Accept-all persistent-state feature is fully verified and needs no re-test unless the component changes. Reusable helper: /app/backend/tests/_iter92_seed.py (show/backup/restore/scenario_a/scenario_b/scenario_c <meeting_id>) — always run `backup` before and `restore` after, it writes /tmp/iter92_backup.json. The bulk buttons live on the 'Compliance' tab of /meetings/{id}/report (not the Overview tab) and only render when the user can review, the report isn't locked, and totalCount>0. One transient 401 console error was observed during a page load (axios auth refresh interceptor kicked in and the page worked normally) — worth keeping an eye on but not reproducible on demand.
rca_of_the_issue: No defect found. The implementation derives { total, pending, accepted } per confidence tier from analysis.cqc_mappings + care_cert_mappings + custom_mappings (with legacy needs_review / not_enough_evidence aliased into the possible tier), and only renders the read-only badge when total>0 && pending===0 && accepted>0 — which correctly excludes both the empty-tier and all-rejected cases and makes the state survive reload because it is recomputed from persisted mapping statuses returned by GET /api/review/{id}.
